cues.text: A towering Persona now floats over Fuuka: a woman with long arms spread wide, whose skirt forms a glass dome around Fuuka and Natsuki. You, Akihiko and Junpei stand ready to fight, while Mitsuru and Yukari kneel on the floor beside you. Facing you at the foot of a staircase stand two huge Shadows: a round-bodied one with a fan of white plumes, holding a long staff, and a tall armoured one with a cross on its chest.
